panel.finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/notes/yorkie-note-store.ts::remote edit ops are matched by path prefix (startswith('$.content')), so a peer's ops on a sibling root key are applied to the local editor
panel.summary: Remote edit ops are matched by path prefix (startsWith('$.content')), so a peer's ops on a sibling root key are applied to the local editor
panel.evidence: `subscribeRemote` applies any op whose `path` merely starts with `$.content` (yorkie-note-store.ts:153). Yorkie roots are schemaless, so a collaborator with write access (workspace member, or an `editor`-role share visitor — yorkie-auth.controller.ts:200) can do `root.contentX = new Text(); root.contentX.edit(...)`; the resulting `edit` op has path `$.contentX`, passes the prefix test, and is dispatched into this client's CodeMirror doc (note-sync.ts:43). The victim's view then diverges from `root.content`, and their next keystroke is translated with corrupted coordinates and written back to the real content, corrupting the note for every peer. Requires an already-authorized writer, so impact is integrity-only. The line predates this diff (only the comment above it changed), but the new undo path now flows through the same handler. Fix: compare `=== '$.content'` or anchor on `$.content.`.
